This analysis examines trends in Airbnb data to uncover insights about pricing and room types.

## Rentals by Borough & Room Type

![Distribution of total rentals across NYC boroughs, broken down by room type. Manhattan dominates, with a mix of private rooms and entire homes.](../images/airbnb-1.png){fig-cap="Rentals by Borough & Room Type."}

## Average Price by Borough

![Comparison of average nightly prices across boroughs. Manhattan is the most expensive by far, while the Bronx offers the most affordable stays.](../images/airbnb-2.png){fig-cap="Average Price by Borough"}

## Spatial Price Distribution (Manhattan Focus)

![Map of average rental prices in Manhattan. Properties closer to Central Park and key attractions trend higher, while areas like Hell’s Kitchen are relatively cheaper.](../images/airbnb-3.png){fig-cap="Spatial Price Distribution (Manhattan Focus)"}

## Growth of Unique Hosts Over Time

![Number of new Airbnb hosts entering the NYC market each year. Peak host growth occurred in 2015, followed by a decline due to market saturation and regulation.](../images/airbnb-4.png){fig-cap="Growth of Unique Hosts Over Time."}
